name: What is the difference between remodeling an existing bedroom and building a bedroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between remodeling an existing bedroom and building a bedroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remodel alters the interior features, finishes, and fixtures of your current room, whereas a bedroom addition builds entirely new square footage beyond your existing foundation. Remodeling is ideal when you have underutilized space, an awkward layout, or rooms that need updating for family members. An addition is necessary when your household has outgrown its footprint and requires an entirely new private living area or multi-generational suite. An addition involves exterior foundation and framing work that remodeling an existing room avoids.
acceptedAnswer.description: A remodel updates or reconfigures existing interior space. A bedroom addition builds new square footage attached to the home, which requires new foundation and framing work.
